text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~~!
My cheeks are still all dry~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's strange...
I applied the all-curing magic potion, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Did I get the wrong ingredients...!?
No way! Those leaves weren't the right ones~!?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho ended up worsening her rough skin
after using plant extracts that were bad for it.
